Operation Dawn may refer to:Operation Dawn (1967), a planned Egyptian offensive against Israel
Operation Dawn (1983), an Iranian offensive in the Iran–Iraq War on 10 April 1983
Operation Dawn 2, an Iranian offensive in the Iran–Iraq War on 22 July 1983
Operation Dawn (1997), a Turkish Armed Forces operation in northern Iraq against the Kurdistan Workers Party
Second Battle of Fallujah also known as Operation Al-Fajr (2004), joint US-Iraqi offensive against the insurgent stronghold of Fallujah during the Iraq War
Operation Dawn (2012), a Turkish Armed Forces operation against the Kurdistan Work.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Iranian offensives of Operation Dawn (1983) and Operation Dawn 2 had significant regional impact during the Iran–Iraq War, resulting in thousands of casualties and altering the balance of power in the region. The Turkish Armed Forces' operation of Operation Dawn (1997) also had notable regional implications.
